items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: “You’re gonna play on the second chorus, and over here Eric’s gonna play that thing over there.”

ctx.x: It was the rhythm section. And actually, you know it was Richard Tee that just took the session over. Even though it was my record, he just said, “ok now,” and he would tell everybody what they’re gonna do. “You’re gonna play on the second chorus, and over here Eric’s gonna play that thing over there.” I just let him do it. And I was the organ player, and I played... I forget if my stuff was live. Maybe it was just Stuff itself, who played all the tracks, and afterwards they thought that I was a singer and that I…
There’s one particular, I mean I love them all. There’s one particular tune on here that really captures my attention, it was “Song Sung Long.”
